To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a hybrid neural network combining a self-organizing map (SOM), a convolutional neural net (CNN), and a multi-layer perceptron (ML) can achieve high recognition rates for human face recognition.
the hybrid network is a powerful face recognition system which can be trained to recognize new faces and is invariant to minor changes in facial expression and pose.

the hybrid neural network approach outperformed the other methods, and that a hybrid network combining a SOM and convolutional network outperformed a hybrid network combining the Karhunenko Loeve transform and a multilayr perceptron.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a hybrid neural network system for face recognition.
the design, development, and testing of a hybrid neural network approach to face recognition, and with the analysis of the results.
the design of a system that can recognize human faces under variable lighting conditions, expressions, and facial details.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hybrid system presented here is a very effective face recognition system, which compares favourably to the best systems reported in the literature.
the convolutional neural system is superior to the other two systems.

our system is a significant improvement over the previous state of the art, in both accuracy and robustness, and that the hybrid approach of combining SOMs and convolutional networks provides an effective solution for the face recognition problem.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hybrid neural network provides the best results for face recognition.
the hybrid network performs better than the MLP, and that the hybrid network is more computationally efficient than the MLP.

we have presented a hybrid neural network approach to human face recognition which is robust to changes in expression, pose and facial details, which is capable of handling large databases of images, and which is computationally efficient.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of the SOM and convolutional neural network is an effective approach to face recognition.
the hybrid neural network approach is a promising direction for face recognition, and we hope that our results will encourage further investigation of hybrid neural networks.
the convolutional network provides a significant improvement in recognition performance, and the SOM provides a useful dimensionality reduction.
